body.text: How does factory-direct sourcing in İnegöl compare to Istanbul's Masko and Modoko showrooms?

İnegöl delivers direct factory access, lower unit pricing on volume runs, and transparent production-floor audits, whereas Masko and Modoko concentrate hundreds of retail and trade showrooms in Istanbul for rapid design benchmarking. Many international buyers start in Istanbul to narrow styles before traveling to İnegöl to verify manufacturing capacity and negotiate ex-factory terms.

Türkiye exported roughly $4.6 billion in furniture in 2025, according to the [Federation of Turkish Furniture Associations (MOSFED)](https://mosfed.com/en/message-from-the-chairman-of-the-board-of-directors/) and national trade figures tracked by the [Türkiye Exporters Assembly (TİM)](https://www.tim.org.tr/en/). A substantial share of that output originates in Bursa's İnegöl district, anchored by the [İnegöl Furniture and Woodworking Specialized Organized Industrial Zone (İMOSAB)](https://www.imosab.org.tr/), whose legal establishment and industrial infrastructure are documented by the [İnegöl Chamber of Commerce and Industry (İTSO)](https://www.itso.org.tr/en/inegol-furniture-industrial-zone).

In Istanbul, [Masko Furniture City](https://www.masko.com.tr/?lang=en) sits in Başakşehir on the European side, while [Modoko](https://www.modoko.com.tr/) operates in Ümraniye on the Asian side with around 350 brands. Both centers help architects and hoteliers compare finishes quickly, though showrooms often add retail margins or represent third-party workshops.
What hospitality, residential and bespoke contract furniture capabilities exist?

Turkish workshops and mid-sized factories manufacture full-scope hospitality FF&E, residential collections, and bespoke contract millwork—including upholstered seating, solid beech and oak dining pieces, hotel headboards, and metal-framed lounge furniture. Most export-ready İnegöl plants handle custom CAD shop drawings, flame-retardant foams, and buyer-specified fabrics when minimum quantities or project budgets justify dedicated tooling.

For hospitality and commercial developments, buyers should verify fire-retardancy documentation (such as BS 5852 or EN 1021 fabric standards), kiln-dried timber moisture levels, and hardware provenance (soft-close hinges and drawer slides). Smaller Modoko ateliers excel at one-off architectural commissions, while larger İnegöl plants scale identical room sets across 50 to 300 hotel keys.
How do 20ft/40ft container consolidation and export packing work?

Multi-supplier orders are typically gathered at a licensed logistics warehouse near Bursa or Istanbul, where goods undergo quality checks before loading into 20ft standard or 40ft high-cube containers. Export-grade packing uses multi-layer bubble wrap, corrugated corner guards, moisture-control desiccants, and ISPM-15 heat-treated wooden crates for marble, glass, or lacquered surfaces.

Because international shipping involves customs declarations, EUR.1 or A.TR movement certificates, and commercial contract enforcement, Itinerary of Türkiye operates strictly as a non-legal, non-broker travel and visit advisory. We coordinate factory visits, schedules, and independent introductions; contracts, customs clearance, export compliance, and legal or tax due diligence belong exclusively to licensed Turkish customs brokers, attorneys, and official authorities.

items: Pre-loading inspection: Verify frame stability, upholstery stitching, and finish consistency against signed samples before wrapping.
Carton labeling: Confirm SKU codes, room numbers, and gross/net weights match the packing list.
Wood packaging compliance: Ensure wooden pallets and crates carry valid ISPM-15 stamps for EU, UK, US, or Gulf entry.
Container sealing: Record container and bolt-seal numbers alongside loading photographs for your freight forwarder.

body.text: How many days do showroom + factory visits take?

Plan three to four full working days for a productive furniture sourcing trip across Istanbul and Bursa. One day covers Masko or Modoko showroom benchmarking in Istanbul, followed by two days of factory-floor audits in İnegöl, leaving a fourth day for sample revisions, fabric selection, or final meetings before departure.

Travel between Istanbul and Bursa runs smoothly via the Osmangazi Bridge or fast ferry to Mudanya, taking roughly two to two-and-a-half hours depending on Istanbul traffic. Combining your factory schedule with a comfortable base in [Bursa](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/destinations/bursa) cuts daily highway fatigue and allows early-morning arrivals at İMOSAB gates.

faq.q: Can I buy directly from İnegöl factories for a single villa project?
faq.a: Yes, several mid-sized İnegöl workshops accept full-villa orders if total volume approaches a 20ft container or meets their project minimum. Smaller single-room purchases are usually easier through Masko or Modoko showrooms.

faq.q: Do Masko and Modoko showrooms handle international shipping?
faq.a: Many showrooms work with third-party freight forwarders to arrange door-to-port or door-to-door delivery. Always verify packing standards, insurance terms, and customs clearance responsibilities with your licensed broker before paying deposits.

faq.q: How far is İnegöl from Istanbul Airport (IST) and Sabiha Gökçen (SAW)?
faq.a: İnegöl is roughly 2 hours from Sabiha Gökçen Airport (SAW) via the Osmangazi Bridge and 2.5 to 3 hours from Istanbul Airport (IST), depending on bridge and ring-road traffic.

faq.q: What is the best time of year to visit Turkish furniture factories?
faq.a: Spring and autumn offer mild travel weather and full factory staffing. January is also popular around the International Istanbul Furniture Fair (IIFF), though factory floors can be busy with exhibition orders.

faq.q: Does Itinerary of Türkiye negotiate prices or sign supplier contracts?
faq.a: No. Itinerary of Türkiye coordinates travel logistics, factory appointments, and independent introductions. Price negotiations, legal contracts, quality guarantees, and customs clearance remain strictly between you, your suppliers, and your licensed legal or customs advisors.

faq.q: Should I bring fabric swatches and CAD drawings to factory visits?
faq.a: Yes. Bringing physical swatches, Pantone references, and dimensioned CAD drawings lets İnegöl technical teams quote realistic lead times, timber grades, and foam densities on the spot.
